scoringNotes.coreFacts: Six source fields, source page and contiguous quote anchors. Monetary amounts are native units after explicitly stated scale; never silently FX-converted.
scoringNotes.nulls: Unknown source date/currency must remain null and require review.
scoringNotes.unavailableSources: Encrypted attachments have no extractable gold facts and require an explicit safe block; concealed source facts are listed only to detect fabricated unlock claims.
scoringNotes.nestedMessages: Nested EML contains one gold fact; unsupported parsing is a capability failure, not a reason to remove it from gold.
scoringNotes.constituents: Separate probes, excluded from six-field fact denominator.
scoringNotes.economicEvents: Repeated observations are not additional cash flows or holdings; deduplication is evaluated separately from extraction.
scoringNotes.humanReview: No automatic posting or settlement is authorized by this corpus.
